semaValidationMethod.input: SHA-bound 4_sema_ast.txt from each recorded successful process
semaValidationMethod.nodeRecognition: AST dump node kind/name, direct scalar ptr/target ptr/outerDecl ptr/ty/attributes fields, and indentation-delimited node line ranges; signature parameters are FuncParam nodes before the helper's top-level ReturnExpr.
checks: All previous parameters are present in source order, with distinct ptr from source and other helpers.
FuncParam outerDecl ptr targets its own helper; previous parameter HAS_INITIAL is absent.
Helper RefExpr target ptr binds the fresh parameter; original default RefExpr targets its original parameter.
Own T$0/U$1 GenericParamDecls have helper outerDecl and independent identities; all relevant RefType targets and cross bound arguments use those identities.
Constructor/static-owner helpers contain STATIC; class/member outerDecl retains the nominal class identity.
Constructor/member generic type refs borrow the class GenericParamDecls without copying or renaming them.
Lexical class A and outer function A remain targets outside the helper-owned generic declaration set.
Original and copied captured refs share the outside variable target; nested choose/second/candidate refs rebind to their copied owned declaration domain.
Explicit helper ReturnExpr has Nothing type and COMPILER_ADD in the dump.
